property_summary: When all external transferFrom calls succeed, the reference returns true, but the buggy version returns false.
For any sequence of successful external transferFrom calls, the transfer function must return true; the buggy version returns false even when all calls succeed.
For any call to transfer that completes without reverting, the reference returns true, but the buggy version returns false.

For any call to transfer with nonzero-length tos and a callee address that successfully executes all transferFrom calls without reverting, the reference returns true; the buggy version returns false for the same successful execution.
For any admissible input where all internal transferFrom calls succeed, the reference transfer function returns true, while the buggy version returns false.
For any valid input where the call does not revert, the transfer function in the correct contract always returns true, while the buggy one always returns false.
For any input where the external call does not revert, the transfer function must return true; the buggy version returns false instead.
For every non-reverting call to transfer, the correct C returns true while the buggy M returns false.
For every input where the transfer function does not revert, the return value must equal the logical AND of all sub-call successes; the bug hardcodes false regardless.
For any valid call to transfer that does not revert due to internal execution, the return value must be true; the mutant incorrectly returns false because _tos.length > 0 holds after the require.
